name: Unishire Urban Infra Limited
summary: Unishire Urban Infra Limited focuses on the development and construction within the real estate sector. The company's operations are divided into two primary divisions: Infrastructure and Real Estate. Its various projects are located across both North and South Bangalore. The Infrastructure division is responsible for construction endeavors involving roads, railways, ports, irrigation, power, and related developments. Conversely, the Real Estate segment is dedicated to broader real estate activities. The firm was founded on April 23, 1991, and its main office is situated in Bangalore, India.
